events.title: Make Inclusive Tech Sunday @ Tampines Library | MakeIT
events.age_note: The age requirement for participants is 13+, regardless of abilities, knowledge & expertise.
events.description: Drop by Tampines Library for Make Inclusive Tech Sundays! (M.I.T Sundays!) Learn about assistive tech(tech that helps with special needs), participate in co-creating low-cost, custom-fit assistive devices for persons with disabilities in MakeIT with Salvage Garden!

registration.note: Registration is required. There are no seats available but a waiting list is available.

events.title: [DiscoverTech]  Upcycle & Engineer: Creative Building with MAKEDO
events.age_note: This programme is suitable for children aged 5-8 years old, is age appropriate and requires registration.
events.description: Step into the role of a young engineer and discover how creative ideas can be transformed into purposeful, sustainable designs! In this hands-on workshop, children will explore key engineering concepts such as structure, stability, joining and strengthening as they work through the process of imagining, building, testing and improving their own creations.

registration.note: Registration is required. There are 37 seats available.

events.age_note: This programme is suitable for participants aged 13 and above.
events.description: Electronics can be used to create a wide variety of exciting projects, but getting started can sometimes feel overwhelming. In this workshop, you will explore the BOSON sensor system, which is designed to work seamlessly with the microcontrollers available at MakeIT. Through a series of hands-on activities, you will learn how different sensors and modules can be combined to build simple interactive projects.

events.title: Herbs, Spices and Stories: A Cyanotype Workshop | TOYLC26
events.age_note: This programme is suitable for seniors.
events.description: Join us for a special workshop that brings together literary appreciation and hands-on craftmaking! At this session, led by artist Madhvee Deb, participants will read selected texts on food, memory and home and reflect on how food connects us to people, places, and shared experiences.

registration.note: Registration is required. There are no seats available but a waiting list is available.

events.title: [Teens Takeover | arts] Blue Mosque Art Cart: Beginner Chinese Calligraphy Workshop
events.age_note: This programme is suitable for teens aged 13 to 17.
events.description: Lim Tze Peng is known for his nostalgic depictions of Singapore captured via ink paintings and Chinese calligraphy. Untitled (Blue Mosque) (c. Late 1970s) presents Lim’s interpretation of Sultan Mosque and its surrounding areas, located in the Kampong Glam district today. While the mosque is no longer blue, the artwork reflects a culmination of his memories of the mosque from the 1950s to 1960s.

registration.note: Registration is required. There are 10 seats available.
